title: InPlaceMigrator.migrateIn surplus-underfunding batch revert + no cross-slice surplus reservation
description: story-013's gross-up top-up math (topup = mulDiv(amt - credited, amt, credited), src/InPlaceMigrator.sol:276) silently introduces a surplus pre-funding requirement that is invisible at the call site: the operator must separately pre-fund grossed-up surplus over and above the parked principal, or a migrateIn slice that routes through a haircutting strategy fails require(topup <= balanceOf - totalParked) (:280-281) and the whole batch reverts atomically. Earlier greedy slices can also exhaust the shared surplus, stranding later paginated slices (no per-slice surplus reservation). Folds CODE-002: the surplus require subtracts balanceOf - totalParked (:281), underflowing to panic 0x11 instead of a readable revert when surplus is exhausted, masking the under-funding root cause.
impact: None to principal. Failure mode is an atomic revert of the migrateIn batch with zero value leak; no silent under-credit. Parked principal stays escrowed under totalParked and is recoverable. The migration leg is RETRYABLE (operator pre-funds the grossed-up surplus and re-runs) and every user can independently self-recover via the permissionless, self-scoped claimTimedOut (:306). The migration is DEFERRED, not permanently DoS'd. Law-3 non-obvious owner footgun: a competent operator running the documented migrateOut -> reset -> migrateIn runbook would be surprised that migrateIn bricks unless they performed a separate, undocumented gross-up pre-funding step. CONDITIONAL-MEDIUM declined (recoverable; no availability impairment).
attackPath: Not an attack. Operator runs the documented migrateOut -> reset -> migrateIn runbook.
A migrateIn slice routes through a haircutting strategy; gross-up topup = mulDiv(amt - credited, amt, credited) (:276).
require(topup <= balanceOf - totalParked) (:280-281) fails because the operator did not separately pre-fund the grossed-up surplus.
Whole batch reverts atomically (greedy earlier slices can also exhaust shared surplus, stranding later paginated slices).
Recovery: operator pre-funds surplus and re-runs; OR each user calls permissionless self-scoped claimTimedOut (:306) to recover parked principal.
recommendation: Document the gross-up surplus pre-funding precondition at the call site and in the runbook. Reserve per-slice surplus before paginating (cross-slice reservation) so an earlier greedy slice cannot strand a later one. Replace the underflow-prone require(topup <= balanceOf - totalParked) with an explicit comparison that emits a readable surplus-exhausted revert instead of panic 0x11.
